## Context

`templates/rebar-usage.md` currently instructs every project to pass `--assignee <you>` and lists six link relations. The claim command already applies `ticket.default_assignee` when the option is omitted. A repository may leave that setting empty, in which case claim remains valid and records no assignee. An explicit value is an override and must be suitable for the configured Jira bridge when one is present. `templates/AGENTS.md` embeds a synchronized generated region from the usage template. Ticket bilingual-raptorial-furseal deliberately left these templates unchanged because adopter repositories may lack a default assignee. Tickets stun-wraith-conch, weariless-scrapable-mouse, isogonal-wedded-catfish, and dolorous-coverable-mice establish the current behavior and synchronized ownership.

## Plan

- Make the portable claim example omit `--assignee`.
- Explain the configured default and the valid unassigned result when no default exists.
- State the conditions for an explicit Jira-resolvable identity without assuming that every client repository uses Jira.
- Add `caused_by` to the link inventory.
- Add dependency-ordered plan review guidance that tells clients to review prerequisites before dependents.
- Synchronize the generated region in `templates/AGENTS.md` through the established template ownership mechanism.
- Preserve the existing byte-synchronization test and add focused behavior assertions.
- Exclude repository-specific Gerrit workflow guidance from the portable template.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The canonical template presents `rebar claim <id>` as the default command.
- [ ] The template describes behavior when `ticket.default_assignee` is configured.
- [ ] The template describes behavior when `ticket.default_assignee` is empty.
- [ ] Explicit assignee guidance requires email or accountId only for a Jira-reconciled store when an override is intended.
- [ ] The link inventory includes `caused_by`.
- [ ] Plan review guidance requires prerequisites before dependents.
- [ ] The canonical template contains no repository-specific Gerrit workflow guidance.
- [ ] The generated region in `templates/AGENTS.md` matches `templates/rebar-usage.md`.
- [ ] Focused template synchronization and behavior tests pass.
